definitions: Cow's milk from which water has been removed (roughly 60% of it) and to which sugar has been added, making it a very sweet, thick product.
A canned milk product that is very sweet and thick, used in desserts and baking.
examples: The recipe calls for a can of condensed milk.
She drizzled condensed milk over the fruit salad.
Condensed milk is a key ingredient in many no-bake desserts.
